FIRST read animations/SHARED.md fully — especially the reel-06 Project specifics (MARKER LAYER, THE FUNNEL, READABILITY, Words on screen) — and look at the style frames it lists, plus ~/Desktop/reels/reel-06/edit/verify/style_test_v2_red.png (the approved marker look). FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene — HOOK.
Spoken: 'If you're watching this video or you have built anything with AI, you are probably in the top 0.2%'
TEXT HOOK (user-approved, the one exception to words.txt): 'you're in the top 0.2%' — FULLY READABLE ON FRAME 0 (thumbnail), whole scene, top of the zone (y ~295–560): e.g. 'you're in the top' ~96 ink on line 1, '0.2%' ~200 RED on line 2 with a red marker LOOP already drawn around it on frame 0 (M.circle with at=0, boiling). Continuous life (1 % breathe), no entrance.
SPEAKER: PORTRAIT hero card (~740x820) below the hook (y ~600–1420), ~90 % settled on frame 0, settled by 0.3 s. data-face 0.42.
KINETIC: 'built anything' ~120 ink lands on 'built' (1.54)/'anything' (1.92), 'with AI' with 'AI' ~170 RED on 'AI' (2.34) — land them on paper/strip in the lower part of the card, collage-staggered, they blur out by ~3.2. Then the HERO: 'top 0.2%' — 'top' ~110 ink (3.50) and '0.2%' ~230 RED stamp-in on '0.2%' (3.76) low on the card (paper strip/glow), 1.45→0.95→1 stamp + 1 % punch = IMPACT. On the stamp: a black-marker DOUBLE underline scribbles under it (M.underline double) and 5–7 tiny red marker 'sparkle ticks' (short M.line dashes radiating) flick out around it, then boil. Secondary: a small red marker arrow draws from the hook's '0.2%' down toward the kinetic '0.2%' at ~3.6 (connecting the two). Keep the hook readable throughout, no collisions.
Word times are scene-local (exact ones in words.txt; contact frame 0.13–0.2 s before the word). Everything inside x 60–960 / y 285–1480 (measure). Write beats.json AND marker_beats.json. Hold alive to the cut.

FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene — CHAPTER + REAL POST (bespoke). Spoken: 'Andrej Karpathy, who is the co-founder of OpenAI now at Anthropic, posted a breakdown of how differently people are using AI across the spectrum.' BEAT A — WHO (0–3.0): his REAL avatar hf/assets/karpathy_avatar.jpg as a POLAROID (white frame, ~360 wide, tilted -5°) pressed onto the paper with M.tape at its top on 'Andrej' (0.15) — polaroid arcs in, overshoots, tape pops on. 'Andrej Karpathy' Inter Tight 900 ~120 ink beside/below it on 'Andrej'/'Karpathy' (0.15/0.39). On 'co-founder' (1.21) 'co-founder of' ~80 ink + an OpenAI chip (hf/assets/openai.png in a white rounded chip + 'OpenAI' Inter 600) pops on 'OpenAI' (1.77). On 'now at' (2.19) a RED marker ARROW draws (shaft then head) from the OpenAI chip to an Anthropic chip (hf/assets/anthropic.png + 'Anthropic') that swings in and lands on 'Anthropic' (2.49) — the chip squash-lands. Small speaker card (≥420 wide) in a corner from ~0.1. BEAT B — THE POST (3.0–6.8): everything from A recedes/compacts upward (polaroid shrinks to a corner). On 'posted' (3.13) the REAL post header strip hf/assets/post_header.png + hf/assets/post_funnel.png stack as ONE white card (≥830 px wide so the text is readable) slides up and is taped on (M.tape on 2 corners), an X logo chip (hf/assets/x.png) pops on its corner. 'breakdown' ~150 ink lands (3.69). Then hf/assets/post_stats.png slides in under the card as a stats strip and the REAL numbers are emphasised: on 'differently' (4.73) a black marker underlines '6.2m Views', and kinetic '6.2m views' ~110 RED rolls up (odometer 0.0→6.2) beside it. On 'across the spectrum' (6.11–6.61) a hand-drawn spectrum line (M.line, long gentle wave) draws left→right under everything with 4 small tick marks — sets up the funnel. Keep post text ≥ 0.85 scale. FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene — THE FUNNEL IS DRAWN (bespoke hero scene of the reel).
Spoken: 'And he describes it as a funnel. The biggest chunk is about 75% people, which makes up to about 6 billion people in the entire world who have never interacted with AI at all.'
BEAT A (0–1.6): the post card (hf/assets/post_funnel.png, ≥830 wide, top of the zone, same card look as v03) is already there; M.highlight swipes behind 'sharp funnel' on 'describes' (0.63). On 'funnel' (1.45) the card slides up/out FAST and THE FUNNEL draws itself with the SHARED GEOMETRY (FUN.draw over ~1.0 s starting ~0.9: rim, left wall, right wall, spout — a hand drawing it) while 'funnel' ~220 RED lands top-left (y ~380) = hero word, 1 % punch. Dividers draw in quick succession (1.9–2.3).
BEAT B (1.7–5.2): 'biggest chunk' ~110 ink lands on 'biggest' (1.89). Secondary CHARACTERS: 10–14 tiny hand-drawn stick people (M.line heads/bodies, ink, ~40 px tall) drop in an arc from the top and tumble INTO the rim, piling into tier 0 (2.0–3.2), little bounce on landing. On '75%' (3.19) tier 0 hatches in PENCIL grey (FUN.fill(0,…,{color:'pencil', opacity:0.45})) and '75%' ~230 RED stamps in the lower zone (y ~1300–1470); real-post label note '~75%' is NOT needed — use Caveat ink note '6B' later.
BEAT C (4.4–9.27): '6 billion' — an ODOMETER rolls '6,000,000,000' (Inter Tight 900 ~110 ink, digits roll and lock left→right) beside/under '75%' on '6' (5.30)/'billion' (5.46); a red Caveat note '6B' writes next to tier 0 at the right of the funnel (x 720–960). On 'never interacted' (7.46–8.00) a hand-drawn empty CHAT BUBBLE (M.line rounded bubble with a tail + three dots) draws to the right of tier 0 and on 'at all' (8.96) a black marker ✗ (M.cross) slashes across it, bubble shakes once. Small speaker card: at the top-right (≥420 wide) during B–C, or skip if it collides — fill the lower zone.

2) 'stupid emails' (3.01–3.43): an EMAIL draft card (To/Subject wireframe rows, lines writing themselves); kinetic 'stupid emails' ~120 ink.

Earlier cards recede (staging). Fill the lower zone.
